why: 2026-11-12: the only sources are the City of Kulm campground page (kulmnd.com/kulm-campgrounds.html: 'KCDC Campground: 701-647-2878', phone only) and the ND HHS licensed RV park list 07.17.2025 row 197 (KCDC PARK, 6 Main Ave N, owner KULM COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CORP., 7 lots, inspected 4/24/2025). The licence address is the Kulm Clinic building downtown (Google Maps 'Kulm Clinic South Central Health', 6 Main Ave N, 46.30302,-98.94865), and neither Esri 2021-05-24 nor NAIP 2023-06-18 imagery shows RV lots there or anywhere else in town that is not the city campground or Pesek's lot. No Google Maps place, no OSM feature, no rate, hookups, season or site description anywhere; the phone is listed for Kulm Hardware (3 Main Ave N). Location, fee model, rig fit and current operation cannot be confirmed, so no pin can be placed without guessing.
name: KCDC Campground
flags: Not a duplicate of 5993 Kulm City Campground: separate HHS licences (KCDC PARK, owner Kulm Community Development Corp., 7 lots, inspected 4/24/2025 vs KULM PARK, 222 3rd Ave SE, owner CITY OF KULM, 10 lots, inspected 5/1/2025), separate phones on the city page (KCDC 701-647-2878, City Campground 701-269-0014), and the KCDC licence address is ~0.6 km NNW of 5993's pin.

Who runs it: Kulm Community Development Corporation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit (EIN 45-0313579, IRS ruling 2022; ProPublica Form 990 FY2024/FY2025: president Ben Pesek, VP Wes Gackle; rental property income $0, program service revenue $16,152 / $2,715, no breakdown). It is not a government body. Precedent in the DB is split: non-profits running a city/county park are stored local (Bader Memorial 2769, Central States Fairgrounds 5855), non-profits running their own grounds private (Prairie Village 5829, New Town Marina 6038). If it is ever added: local only if the lots are on city land or run for the city, else private, which would bring the price and live-web-presence gates (and it currently has no website, rate or 25-review Google listing, so it would fail presence).

Pesek link (lead 19): KCDC's president is Ben Pesek. OSM has 'Pesek Campground' (way 874194294, operator Ben Pesek, phone 701-320-3799, edited 2026-04-24) as a sand lot at 46.29768,-98.94912 at the south edge of town west of the school, ~0.45 km W of 5993. A search snippet of HHS's July 2023 combined list (that PDF now 404s, so unverified) showed 'Camp Kulm', PO Box 224, owner Ben Pesek Properties LLC; the 07.17.2025 list has no Pesek/Camp Kulm row, only KCDC PARK and KULM PARK in Kulm. So KCDC Park and Pesek Campground may be the same 7 lots relicensed to KCDC, but the city page lists them separately with different phones; not resolved.

Edgeley-Kulm Dam (lead 21) is not this: HHS has no Kulm-Edgeley Dam row (Edgeley Campground, Hwy 281 & 13, Edgeley Park District, 28 lots, is a different place); search snippets put the dam campground ~2 mi S of Edgeley, ~30 km from Kulm.

For 5993 Kulm City Campground (from the Kulm Park Board site sites.google.com/view/kulmparkboard/campground, read 2026-11-12): '18 sites available' (5993 sites.count is 20 from note prose), full hookups 30 & 50 amp, tent sites, fire rings; $10 primitive / $30 daily / $150 weekly / $400 monthly (5993 has no fees); season 'typically the end of May to September (weather dependent for water availability)'; locked self-registration pay station (check or cash), no on-site manager; reservation contact Hannah Bertsch 701-269-0014 plus a Google Forms reservation request; dump station at the north end; showers/restrooms in the pool house during pool hours. HHS KULM PARK licences 10 lots. The park board site could replace or join 5993's kulmnd.com website.

Phone-list line: KCDC Campground, Kulm ND, 701-647-2878 (number listed for Kulm Hardware) - where are the 7 KCDC Park lots, are they open to overnight travellers by the night, rate, hookups/amps, season, is it the same place as Pesek Campground?
